##### Project general facts

Al Ghoroub Tower is a residential development by GJ Properties, located in Ajman. The building features a modern architectural design with smooth façade lines, panoramic glazing, and glass balconies, complemented by a combination of light decorative elements and dark glass surfaces that create a distinctive urban appearance. The project comprises a ground floor, four parking levels, and eight residential floors, offering well-planned 2-bedroom apartments with functional layouts and comfortable living spaces.

Residents benefit from essential amenities designed for convenience and everyday комфорт living. The development includes a spacious entrance lobby and multiple levels of covered parking, ensuring ease of access and practicality. Its strategic location provides quick connectivity to major highways, allowing residents to move easily across the emirate and access key destinations.

Interiors are finished with modern materials, creating a clean and contemporary atmosphere. Apartments come with equipped kitchens, including a cooker, hood, dishwasher, and dryer from a European manufacturer, ensuring practicality for daily use. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to customize their living spaces according to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
